identity.title: [tooling][csdlc-v2] Implemented-phase SIP recovery cannot repair review-blocking goal truth

values.summary: #407 adds a narrow typed implemented-phase SIP Goal recovery operation guarded by review-recovery provenance, with focused regression proof for #286-style repair and fail-closed broad SIP mutation rejection.
actual_changes: Added SemanticOperation::CorrectGoalAfterRecovery as a SIP-only recovery operation.
Authorized the operation only for implemented issues with immediate typed review-recovery provenance and cleared downstream lifecycle truth.
Recorded structured audit evidence with previous/new goal and recovery generation/sequence.
Added focused gate5 regression covering recovered repair, unrecovered rejection, stale generation rejection, retained terminal rejection, and broad SIP mutation rejection.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove recovered implemented SIP Goal repair and fail-closed guard coverage.
